metadata.title: How to build a fire pit.
metadata.description:
So we built a fire pit, and here's some video of that craziness.
BTW, apparently you shouldn't use cinder block because it will break from the heat. Oops. Been a few years of a lot of use so far with no issues to speak of, BUT, be warned that what we did isn't ideal. We didn't know.  :(

nodes.plm_action: Building the fire pit ring
nodes.plm_caption:
This video shows a timelapse of several people preparing an area for some sort of outdoor structure, possibly a fire pit or well. You see several piles of blocks and bricks and several people putting them in place to form a foundation. There is also a fire going around the end of the day. It shows a square area of dirt with the walls of a structure beginning to form in a circle, then a circular hole in the ground with blocks around it, and finally a finished structure made of cement with a fire burning in the center.
The blocks on the right start out as tan, but turn brown with cement and turn white and grey, also with cement. The area that was dug out for the structure is a square, then after construction it is circular. You see several people, possibly including a child, placing the stones around the structure.

summary.brief: Timelapse of constructing a circular fire‑pit foundation and later gathering around the lit pit.
summary.detailed: The video opens with an overhead view of a cleared patch of soil where a circular outline is marked. A hole is dug and cinder blocks are positioned around the perimeter to form the pit walls. Crushed rock or gravel is spread inside the circle, and a layer of pavers is laid to create a level base. The surrounding area is backfilled with dirt, making the surface even. A tube of landscaping caulk is then applied to the block joints, and decorative stone toppers are placed around the rim to finish and lock the structure in place. The construction sequence ends with a completed circular fire‑pit ring. In the final shots a small fire burns in the center of the pit while several people sit on lawn chairs, stand nearby, and chat around the warm glow.

action.detailed: Place cinder blocks in a circular pattern, fill the interior with crushed rock, lay pavers on the base, backfill the surrounding soil, apply landscaping caulk to the block joints, and set decorative stone toppers to secure the completed pit.
action.actor: One or more people (builders) handling the blocks, rock, caulk and stones

nodes.plm_action: Leveling the gravel bed to ensure a solid foundation
nodes.plm_caption: The video begins with a view from above a circular arrangement of blocks on the ground. Then we see the stack of blocks, a hole dug out, blocks laid down, then covered in dirt. We also see blocks covered in a substance that hardens once exposed to the sun. Once hard we can see the circle of blocks, a pile of cement and the blocks around the circle laid down and covered in soil and grass. The frame pans out to reveal a larger area of a yard which then pans back to the circle of blocks. We see a hand reaching to touch the blocks and finally we see the opening of the squeeze tube used to apply liquid nails. The video ends with the liquid nails tube opening.

summary.brief: Timelapse of building a circular fire pit, from excavating the base to sealing the masonry with adhesive.
summary.detailed: The video opens with an overhead view of a circular layout of blocks on the ground. A person begins by digging a round pit, then places cinder blocks and decorative stone around the edge to form the fire‑pit wall. The interior is backfilled with soil and smoothed, and the newly laid stones are sprayed with water from a hose. Additional brick layers are added around the perimeter. A hand reaches in to touch the blocks, and the camera briefly pans out to show the surrounding yard before returning to the pit. The segment ends with a close‑up of a squeeze tube of landscaping adhesive (liquid nails) being opened and prepared for use.

action.detailed: Dig a circular hole, arrange cinder blocks and decorative stone around its edge, backfill and compact the soil, spray water onto the masonry, and apply landscaping adhesive to lock the joints in place.
action.actor: a person building the fire pit

nodes.plm_action: Stirring the mixture with gentle circular motions
nodes.plm_caption: This video features a close up shot of a seal of a tube of exterior landscaping caulk then pans quickly from the caulk to a grassy area with a fire pit in the center, with two people to the left of the fire pit and a small wood fire.

summary.brief: A close‑up of a landscaping caulk tube shifts to a backyard fire pit where people gather around a small wood fire.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a tight shot of an “Extreme Landscape” exterior caulk tube and a caulk gun, with a wheelbarrow, tarps and concrete blocks visible in the background. The camera quickly pans left, revealing a neat circular concrete ring surrounded by small stone blocks. A brief cut shows a distant horse on a grassy embankment, after which the view settles on a grassy yard centered on a round fire pit constructed of bricks or stones. A modest wood fire burns in the pit, flanked by large logs. Two people sit on folding chairs to the left of the pit, a white plastic chair sits on the right, and another person approaches the fire while a rope and a red bucket are visible nearby. Green grass, trees, and a white house form the background.

action.detailed: Two people sit on folding chairs beside a small wood fire in a circular brick fire pit while another person approaches, and they converse as the camera pans around the scene.
action.actor: Two people seated on folding chairs (with another person nearby)

nodes.plm_action: Laying stones and gravel around the perimeter
nodes.plm_caption:
The video shows a timelapse of someone laying concrete blocks on a plot of land, and the camera pans over the plot of land as time passes. The timelapse is sped up, with the beginning of the video being in low resolution and the end of the video being in very high resolution. The video starts at night and ends at day time. There is a person making the timelapse, who wears jeans and is barefoot.
The plot of land is made of reddish-brown soil and has green grass along the edges. In the centre of the plot of land is a circular arrangement of building bricks, and outside the circle there is more building bricks. On the left of the bricks there is a pile of white concrete blocks. To the right of the plot of land is a larger plot of land that has a greyish-brown soil, and it has a large pile of brown soil. There is some concrete blocks to the left of this plot of land. As time passes, the person in the video uses a rake, a shovel, and a spade to move the soil and the bricks into the correct positions.
A person wearing jeans and a shirt with a white collar stands next to a large pile of bricks in the video. It looks like the video has been made by this person. There are three bags of soil that are placed on the ground, one to the left of the second pile of bricks, and one on the right of the third pile of bricks. The camera begins near the pile of concrete blocks on the left side of the plot of land and ends where the circular arrangement of building bricks is, and the person stands next to the bricks.

summary.brief: Timelapse of a backyard fire‑pit foundation being built, showing soil preparation, block laying, and final watering.
summary.detailed: The video opens at night on a reddish‑brown soil area edged with green grass, with a pile of white concrete blocks on the left; a barefoot person wearing jeans and a white‑collared shirt uses a shovel, rake and spade to dig and level a circular hole in the centre, spreads gravel, then arranges decorative bricks and concrete blocks—alternating horizontal and vertical placements—to create a uniform circular ring, while three bags of soil, a hammer and a level sit nearby; as the timelapse speeds forward the lighting shifts to daylight and the camera pans across the site, ending with the builder spraying water from a hose over the completed base before pulling back.

action.detailed: Dig a circular hole, level the soil, spread gravel, arrange bricks and concrete blocks around the perimeter to form a circular foundation, and finish by spraying water over the base.
action.actor: a barefoot person wearing jeans and a white‑collared shirt

nodes.plm_action: Laying out bricks and pavers for a circular fire pit design
nodes.plm_caption:
A timelapse video of a man working on building a round fire pit outside with brick and sand on the ground. It goes from beginning to end, including him holding a container of glue that he pours on the sides of the fire pit. You can see how the dirt piles up. It's set to the beat of some background music.
The man wearing brown pants and boots stands in front of a large circular brick construction on the ground of dirt. He reaches down in front of him and picks up a yellow brick from the lower row of brick, then moves the yellow brick to the side next to him on the dirt and he starts placing the same yellow brick on top of the surrounding white brick.
There is a brown wall on the left side that goes up towards the top. A silver fence can be seen in the background with trees to the left and right, and some other structures in the background. The man's feet are visible at the beginning and end.

summary.brief: A man builds a circular fire‑pit by adding bricks in layers and then seals the joints with an adhesive tube.
summary.detailed: The segment begins with a partially built circular fire‑pit surrounded by dirt, grass and a background of trees, a silver fence and a low brown wall. The man wearing brown pants and boots walks around the pit, bends down, picks up a yellow brick from the lower row, places it beside him, and then sets it on top of the surrounding white bricks, adding a new layer to the ring. He repeats this process, adding two more brick layers and a final top brick to complete the stone circle. After the brickwork is finished he lifts a tube of “Extreme Landscape” adhesive, squeezes it and runs the glue along the seams of the brick ring to lock the stones together. The camera focuses closely on the adhesive tube before the segment ends.

action.detailed: Pick up each brick, position it on the existing ring, press it into place, and then squeeze the adhesive tube along the joints to seal the bricks.
action.actor: Man in brown pants and boots

nodes.plm_action: Building a fire pit using cinder blocks
nodes.plm_caption:
This video contains a series of unrelated clips, including a shot of a yard with a fire pit in the centre, two people sat in chairs talking and a third person putting wood into a fire.
The first two clips are poor quality and lack good detail. The last clip is high quality with an O.K. aspect ratio.

summary.brief: A caulk tube is shown being used on a brick circle, a horse runs by, then people gather around a backyard fire pit.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a close‑up of an Extreme Landscape caulk tube held by a hand; a wheelbarrow, tarp and grass are visible as the caulk is applied to the gaps of a circular brick structure on a patch of dirt. The camera then shows the partially built circle of light‑colored stones with the wheelbarrow nearby, followed by a sunny shot of a finished concrete ring surrounded by small square stone bricks and a few reeds. A quick cut presents a horse moving up an embankment, a red object clamped in its mouth, against a grassy backdrop. The scene then shifts to handheld, shaky footage of a backyard fire pit set in a circle of gray bricks on grass under trees. Two people sit in folding chairs on the left, chatting while a fire of logs burns in the pit; a wooden pole with a rope hangs over the flames, a small grey‑and‑white dog walks past, a woman pushes a red wheelbarrow toward the fire, and another person pushes a white plastic lawn chair into the fire’s vicinity. The camera pans upward, showing the group sitting closer together with trees and a white house in the distant background.

action.detailed: Sit in folding chairs around the fire pit, watch the flames, and occasionally move a chair or wheelbarrow while conversing.
action.actor: two people seated in folding chairs (with an additional person moving a chair or wheelbarrow)

nodes.plm_action: Swinging on the swing set
nodes.plm_caption:
The video shows a few people sitting and standing around a fire pit on a lawn. One person sits on a chair next to the fire pit and another person is standing behind them. The fire pit is small and has a white plastic chair in front of it. There is one large log on either side of the fire pit. Two people walk towards the fire pit.
The scene is set outdoors in a yard with a well-kept lawn, trees, and a white house visible in the distance.

summary.brief: A few people gather around a small fire pit on a lawn.
summary.detailed: The camera shows a compact fire pit placed on a well‑kept lawn with a white plastic chair positioned in front of it and a large log on each side. One person is seated on a chair next to the pit while another person stands directly behind the seated individual. Two additional people walk toward the fire pit, joining the small gathering. In the background, green grass, trees, and a white house are visible.

action.detailed: Sit on the chair beside the fire pit, stand behind the seated person, and walk toward the pit as others join.
action.actor: the people gathered around the fire pit

nodes.plm_action: Pouring gravel into the hole
nodes.plm_caption: A time-lapse film of a person building something using bricks. The person first shows several bricks on a ground and then starts building a wall by lining them up one at a time.

summary.brief: A brief window view leads into a timelapse of a single person digging, leveling, and laying cinder blocks and bricks to form a circular fire‑pit foundation.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a short shot of an interior window that has a Snoopy sticker, showing rain and trees outside. The camera then cuts to a wide view of an open grassy field. Shortly after, a timelapse begins showing one builder working alone. First, a shallow pit is dug and the soil is leveled with a shovel and rake. Gravel is spread across the cleared area. The builder then arranges cinder blocks and decorative bricks around the edge of the pit, forming a roughly circular ring. Additional blocks are placed and adjusted, mortar is applied, and a final layer of bricks is set to complete the circular wall that will serve as the fire‑pit base. The sequence ends with a brief pan around the finished stone circle surrounded by grass and dirt.

action.detailed: Lay cinder blocks and bricks in a circle around a dug‑out pit, spread gravel inside, and apply mortar to secure the blocks, completing the fire‑pit base.

nodes.plm_action: Raising the wall to cover the bottom edge of the patio form with bricks
nodes.plm_caption: The video is a time-lapse of the installation of a small brick fire pit. At the end of the video, the work is completed and the camera pans out. The surrounding area is muddy and has some construction debris. This time-lapse video is the only thing present.

summary.brief: A time‑lapse shows a person building a circular fire‑pit base and then spraying water over the site before panning out.
summary.detailed: The clip begins with a fast‑forwarded view of a person arranging bricks and cinder‑block pieces around a circular outline on reddish‑brown soil, forming the rim of a fire‑pit foundation. Additional blocks are added to complete the perimeter while the surrounding ground is covered with mud and construction debris. Once the masonry work is finished, the person directs a hose and sprays water onto the soil and the newly built ring. The segment ends with a brief outward pan that reveals the completed base surrounded by mud, scattered debris, and patches of grass.

action.detailed: Lay bricks and cinder‑block pieces around a circular outline to form the fire‑pit rim, then spray water with a hose onto the surrounding soil.

nodes.plm_action: Applying high-performance acrylic sealant to edges of wall
nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a construction of a fire pit. There is a man's voice as well as the people working in the background.
This video begins with a view of the ground with a fire pit foundation made out of bricks in the center. In the background are the green grass and trees beyond that there is a metal fence and a house.
The video then transitions to a view looking down at the ground at the brick foundation again and the man's hand is seen pointing down towards the pit. The man takes the camera from the angle of the foundation and the view goes back to the grass behind it.
Next the video pans to the bottom of the pit as the man is pointing down again.
In the next view the camera moves around the fire pit and shows the bricks that have been built around the bottom.
The next view is of the man and his co-worker adding two more layers of bricks.
The video then shows the person adding two more layers of bricks to the fire pit.
The final view shows the bottom bricks added and another final brick before the video fades to black.

summary.brief: A circular fire pit is built by stacking bricks around a foundation.
summary.detailed: The clip opens on a brick foundation for a fire pit set in a grassy yard with trees, a metal fence and a house in the background. A man points at the pit, and the camera pans down to the bottom of the circle and then circles around the base, showing the lower ring of bricks already in place. The man and a co‑worker then add successive rows of bricks, building two more concentric layers around the bottom of the pit. A final brick is placed on the top of the last layer, a tube of liquid‑nail adhesive is shown, and the scene ends with the completed ring fading to black.

action.detailed: Place successive rows of bricks around the circular foundation, stacking them into concentric layers to form the fire‑pit walls and finish with a top brick.

nodes.plm_action: Get the sealant
nodes.plm_caption: The video shows a caulk in the hand of a person. The background appears to be an outdoor scene of grass, a wall of bricks, and dirt. The camera zooms in on the caulk. The caulk is white. It has a large green and beige label attached. The label says "EXTREME LANDSCAPE" across in bold. Below the words are several lines of less bold font, most of which cannot be made out. The caulk is moved back and forth throughout the video. At 1s the caulk moves further to the right. At the very end of the video, the caulk moves further to the left.

summary.brief: A hand holds a white landscaping‑caulk tube labeled “EXTREME LANDSCAPE” and slides it side‑to‑side in front of grass and a partial brick fire‑pit.
summary.detailed: In this short clip a person’s hand grasps a white tube of Extreme Landscape caulk whose label is primarily green with beige/gold lettering. The tube is tilted toward the camera so the label is visible, then moved first to the right and later to the left, creating a back‑and‑forth motion. Behind the tube the scene shows a patch of green grass, a wall of bricks forming an incomplete circular fire‑pit, and some dirt, all slightly out of focus. The motion highlights the product’s branding before the clip ends.

action.detailed: Hold the Extreme Landscape caulk tube up to the camera and move it side‑to‑side to showcase the label.

nodes.plm_action: Positioning bricks at an angle to construct the fire pit
nodes.plm_caption: The video shows a tube of Extreme Landscape in front, then cuts to a round platform of small bricks, then quickly cuts to a shot of a horse with a red object in its mouth, walking through a grassy landscape and up an embankment.

summary.brief: A caulk tube is shown as a person applies it to a circular brick fire‑pit, then the view shifts to a horse with a red object moving across a grassy field.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a close‑up of an Extreme Landscape caulk tube; a hand holds the caulk gun and runs it along the gaps of a round brick fire‑pit while a wheelbarrow, grass and trees are visible in the background. The camera then shows a wider shot of the completed circular brick platform set in red dirt and grass. Almost immediately, the scene cuts to a distant view of a horse—carrying a red object and ridden by a person—walking up an embankment across a green lawn framed by trees and houses.

action.detailed: Apply Extreme Landscape caulk to seal the joints of the circular brick fire‑pit, moving the caulk gun along the gaps while a wheelbarrow and surrounding grass are visible.
action.actor: A person holding an Extreme Landscape caulk gun

nodes.plm_action: Building a bonfire
nodes.plm_caption: The camera, handheld and a bit shaky, captures a scene of people sitting around a burning fire in a backyard. Two people sit on folding chairs on the left side of the screen, while in the centre there is a pile of sticks with a fire burning. On the right side there is an empty white plastic chair, also containing a burning pile of sticks. The fire pit has gray bricks surrounding it. To the right, a woman with a red wheelbarrow is approaching the fire. The surroundings include green grass and tall trees. The video ends with an upward shot of the scene, showing everyone sitting closer together in chairs.

summary.brief: Two women sit in folding chairs beside a brick fire pit while a third person approaches with a red wheelbarrow.
summary.detailed: The handheld camera opens on two women seated in folding chairs on the grass next to a circular fire pit made of gray bricks, where logs burn and a rope‑tied pole stands in the flame; an empty white plastic lawn chair is positioned nearby and a small grey‑and‑white dog walks past. The view briefly focuses on the fire before panning to the right, where a third person appears, pushing a red wheelbarrow toward the pit as the seated pair continue chatting. The shot then tilts upward, showing the group gathered closer together amid the grass, trees and surrounding yard.

action.detailed: The person walks while pushing a red wheelbarrow toward the brick fire pit, placing it beside the flames as the others remain seated.
action.actor: a person pushing a red wheelbarrow

nodes.plm_action: Raking leaves and debris to create a layered, textured pile
nodes.plm_caption: The video shows a campfire scene. The setting has a white house and a white fence visible behind the campfire.
nodes.llama3_caption: This image depicts a serene backyard scene, with a small fire burning in a fire pit at its center. The fire pit is surrounded by a bed of dirt, and a few plants and flowers are visible to the right. In the background, a person is sitting on a bench, while another person is standing to the left, leaning against a tree. The yard is filled with trees and lush green grass, and a white house can be seen in the distance. The overall atmosphere of the image is one of tranquility and relaxation, evoking a sense of a peaceful outdoor gathering or campfire setting.

nodes.plm_action: Start a fire pit ring or fire ring
nodes.plm_caption: A group of people are sitting around a campfire in a backyard with green grass, enjoying it. There are a couple of people sitting in lawn chairs and there is a big tree. In the middle of them is a fire pit with red embers and the fire is bright red. There is also a red object laying on the ground by the fire. There are also houses and trees behind the fire.

nodes.plm_action: Laying down plastic sheet on the ground
nodes.plm_caption: This video features a window with a Snoopy sticker at the bottom left. The shot cuts to a large open field.

summary.brief: A window with a Snoopy sticker shows a rainy yard, then the view cuts to a wide grassy field where a man walks past rocks under an overcast sky.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a close‑up of a house window; a Snoopy sticker is visible on the lower left of the glass while rain falls outside, blurring a yard of grass, trees and a distant house. The camera then cuts to an expansive green field under a grey, overcast sky, bordered by tall trees, a low wall and small buildings at the edge. The shot pans leftward across the open lawn, revealing the landscape. A man appears and walks left across the grass, passing several square rocks and the surrounding trees.

action.detailed: Walk leftward across the grassy field, passing several square rocks and trees.

nodes.plm_action: Laying bricks around the edge of the fire pit
nodes.plm_caption: This video captures a fast forward of someone constructing the foundation for a firepit in their backyard. The person digs a pit, lays bricks around the edges, and begins to add the gravel. This is followed by a shot of the finished foundation, which forms the outer edge of the fire pit.

summary.brief: A timelapse shows a person digging a shallow pit, spreading gravel, and arranging cinder blocks into a circular fire‑pit foundation.
summary.detailed: The camera sweeps across a grassy yard as a person uses a shovel and garden fork to excavate a shallow, roughly square hole in the soil. After the earth is cleared, a layer of crushed rock or gravel is spread and roughly leveled inside the excavation. Nearby piles of cinder blocks, concrete pavers and decorative stones are dragged into place. The builder then arranges the blocks around the perimeter of the pit, stacking them in a circular pattern, tapping them into position with a hammer or by hand, and applying mortar to secure the joints. Additional tools such as a rake and a level are used to keep the ring even. The timelapse concludes with a completed circular ring of light‑gray concrete blocks surrounding an empty central space, with exposed red soil and patches of grass around the foundation.

action.detailed: Dig a shallow pit, spread a layer of gravel, then place and stack cinder or concrete blocks around the pit in a circular pattern, using a shovel, fork, rake, level and mortar to position and secure each block.

nodes.plm_action: Placing blocks along top edge of wall
nodes.plm_caption: A sped-up video of a man laying bricks for a garden wall. In a yard with long grass and dirt. The man is on the left of the frame. In the center, a foundation made of white square concrete blocks is being laid. There are bricks on the ground to the right of the foundation.

summary.brief: A man assembles a circular block foundation on a sunny yard.
summary.detailed: In a bright outdoor setting with red‑brown soil and patches of grass, a white‑capped concrete block (cinder‑block) ring is being built. A man standing on the left circles the perimeter, lifting individual blocks from the ground and setting them either upright or flat onto the prepared soil to keep the circle even. He aligns each block as he goes, gradually completing the round foundation. By the end of the clip the circle is nearly closed, with two loose blocks and a white bucket resting beside the structure.

action.detailed: Place each concrete block around the prepared soil, aligning and positioning them to form a continuous circular ring.

nodes.plm_action: Saturate sand with water
nodes.plm_caption: A video of a construction site which appears to be working on a fire pit. A person sprays water onto the surrounding red soil from a hose.

summary.brief: A person sprays water onto the red‑soil base of a circular fire‑pit while bricks are positioned around its edge.
summary.detailed: The camera shows a shallow circular pit framed by red soil and a few patches of grass. A ring of bricks or concrete blocks outlines the pit, with additional bricks scattered nearby. A person stands on the right side holding a garden hose and directs a steady stream of water onto the soil surrounding the pit, wetting the surface. At the same time, bricks are lifted and placed horizontally along the outer edge of the ring, arranging them while daylight casts soft shadows from nearby trees.

action.detailed: Spray a steady stream of water from the hose onto the red soil surrounding the circular fire‑pit foundation, wetting the area while bricks are positioned along its edge.

nodes.plm_action: Backfilling with sand to level base of blocks
nodes.plm_caption: The video shows an outdoor construction of a round concrete pool. The shot pans around the area from left to right, showing a round concrete pool. The construction is still in progress. The cement blocks are still on top of the earth. The water can be seen in the middle of the blocks. The surrounding area is covered in grass, with a couple of big trees in the back. A person's hand can be seen in the bottom left corner of the video. The camera moves in a clockwise motion around the construction area.

summary.brief: A circular fire‑pit frame of cinder blocks is being assembled on a dirt pad while a hand fine‑tunes the top stones.

The person tosses a wooden stick, catches it, and a plank falls onto another plank near the sledgehammer. llm.system_prompt:
You evaluate YouTube videos for a video-understanding benchmark.

You will be given an Action100M-style summary of one video: title, description,
a hierarchical GPT-written summary of the whole video, and a deduplicated list
of action labels extracted at multiple levels of the video.

Your job is to judge:

1) DOMAINS — does this video clearly belong to any of these target domains?
   - "kitchen": a person preparing food in a kitchen-like setting
     (cooking, baking, food prep — NOT eating reviews, NOT pet-food prep,
     NOT food-product unboxing, NOT restaurant vlogs).
   - "manipulation": a person performing hand-object manipulation tasks
     with clear physical goals: assembly/disassembly, repair, crafting,
     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
     someone holds things while talking does NOT count).
   - "navigation": the camera moves through a physical environment as an
     agent traverses space — first-person walking tours (museum, store,
     home, city street), driving / cycling / hiking POV footage, drone
     fly-throughs of indoor or outdoor scenes, room/house walkthroughs.
     The camera's translation through the environment IS the main content.
     Does NOT count: a stationary tripod with someone talking; a tutorial
     filmed in one place; b-roll where the camera only pans or zooms but
     does not translate; sports footage where the player moves but the
     camera stays put.
   A video can match zero, one, or multiple domains. Be strict — when in
   doubt, say "neither".

2) NUM_DISTINCT_EVENTS — count the number of *semantically distinct*
   sub-events (procedural steps) you see in the action list. Merge
   paraphrases of the same step into one. Ignore generic narration steps
   like "speak to camera" or "display title".

3) IS_GOOD_CANDIDATE — true only if BOTH:
   - at least one target domain matches
   - num_distinct_events > 3 (the video shows a real multi-step procedure)

Always return strict JSON in the requested schema.
